body.statement: Fix \(m\ge1\) and \(0<\xi\le a_m\), and let \(n\to\infty\). Uniformly over \(h\in H_m(\xi)\), the local honest oracle has the regular order \[\ell_{n,m}(h)\asymp_{m,\xi,\delta_0}n^{-1/2},\qquad \Phi_{n,m}(h)\asymp_{m,\xi,\delta_0}n^{-1/2}.\] The named signed-cell-mean procedure in \(\mathrm{def:signed-cell-mean-interval}\) has jointly calibrated limiting coverage \[\liminf_{n\to\infty}\inf_{h\in H_m(\xi)}P_{m,h}^{n}\{L_m(h)\in(C^{\mathrm{sign}}_{n,m})_L,\ U_m(h)\in(C^{\mathrm{sign}}_{n,m})_U\}\ge1-\delta_0.\] An attaining full-profile family can be chosen so that \[\sup_{h\in H_m(\xi)}\frac{R_{n,m}(C_{n,m}^{\star},h)}{\ell_{n,m}(h)}=O_{m,\xi,\delta_0}(1).\] Here first-order equivalence means endpoint-center equivalence only: for every \(\varepsilon>0\), \[\sup_{h\in H_m(\xi)}P_{m,h}^{n}\!\left(\sqrt n\left[\left|\operatorname{mid}((C_{n,m}^{\star})_L)-\operatorname{mid}((C^{\mathrm{sign}}_{n,m})_L)\right|+\left|\operatorname{mid}((C_{n,m}^{\star})_U)-\operatorname{mid}((C^{\mathrm{sign}}_{n,m})_U)\right|\right]>\varepsilon\right)\longrightarrow0.\] No expected-length-ratio or Hausdorff equivalence is asserted.
body.justification: This fixed-dimension limit is the precise regular special-case reduction and a falsification check for any claimed all-regime frontier.
body.gap: Fixed-margin influence-function results give a regular endpoint center, but they do not identify the local honest oracle or prove a bounded full-profile oracle ratio on the separated domain.
body.consumer: It recovers conventional efficient endpoint inference in applications whose active max/min operations are well separated.
